style: Instrumental alternative rock, heavy grunge guitar trio recorded live. Electric bass and real drums make the low riff move, with uneven snare answers and space around the attacks. Start with a clean guitar figure, let the same riff widen in a warm dirty guitar sound. A quiet break exposes the pick and strings, followed by an expressive lead guitar passage with sustained bent notes and answering toms. Brief shoegaze noise behind the loudest band moment, then a decisive final band chord and amplifier decay. Pure guitar, bass and drums.
